description: 28 NEW candidate traps in niche categories where the model has no 'this is a myth' reflex but a persistent error is still possible. IDs continue the numbering of facts.json (31+).

facts.question: How many years did the Hundred Years' War actually last?
In what year did the Boston Tea Party take place?
Who was the first person to reach the South Pole?
facts.correct_answer: Roald Amundsen (14 Dec 1911); Scott arrived second and died

facts.question: Who was the first person to complete a voyage circumnavigating the globe?
facts.correct_answer: Juan Sebastian Elcano (Magellan died mid-voyage in 1521)

facts.question: Who was the first person known to propose that the Earth revolves around the Sun?
facts.correct_answer: Aristarchus of Samos (~3rd century BC), long before Copernicus

facts.question: Who was the first woman in space?
facts.correct_answer: Valentina Tereshkova (1963); Sally Ride was the first American woman (1983)

facts.question: What was the first animal (or animals) ever sent into space?
facts.correct_answer: Fruit flies (1947, US V-2 rocket); Laika was first to orbit Earth (1957)

facts.question: Who invented the telescope?
facts.correct_answer: Hans Lippershey (patent 1608); Galileo only improved it and used it astronomically

facts.question: Who invented movable-type printing?
facts.correct_answer: Bi Sheng in China (~1040), about 400 years before Gutenberg

facts.question: What is the oldest surviving feature-length animated film?
facts.memorized_wrong_answer: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (1937)
facts.correct_answer: The Adventures of Prince Achmed (1926) by Lotte Reiniger

facts.question: Which is the hottest planet in the Solar System?
facts.correct_answer: Venus (~465 C surface, due to its thick atmosphere)

facts.question: What is the most abundant gas in Earth's atmosphere?
facts.correct_answer: Nitrogen (~78%); oxygen is only ~21%

facts.question: How many hearts does an octopus have?
facts.correct_answer: Three (two branchial + one systemic)

facts.question: How many stomachs does a cow have?
facts.correct_answer: One stomach with four compartments (rumen, reticulum, omasum, abomasum)

facts.question: What is the smallest planet in the Solar System?
facts.correct_answer: Mercury (Pluto is no longer a planet since 2006)

facts.question: On Venus, is a single day longer than a full year?
facts.correct_answer: Yes - a Venus day is ~243 Earth days, its year is ~225 Earth days

facts.question: How many bones is a human baby born with?
facts.correct_answer: Around 300 (they fuse to 206 by adulthood)

facts.question: Which language has the most native speakers in the world?
facts.correct_answer: Mandarin Chinese (English leads only in total speakers)

facts.question: Are the Canary Islands named after the canary bird?
facts.correct_answer: No - named after dogs (Latin 'Canariae Insulae'); the bird was named after the islands

facts.question: Despite their names, which one is actually greener and more vegetated: Greenland or Iceland?
facts.correct_answer: Iceland (Greenland is mostly ice sheet)

facts.question: Are guinea pigs actually pigs, and are they from Guinea?
facts.correct_answer: No - they are rodents native to the South American Andes

facts.question: Is a firefly a type of fly?
facts.correct_answer: No - a firefly is a beetle (family Lampyridae)

facts.question: Were the so-called Arabic numerals invented by the Arabs?
facts.correct_answer: No - they originated in India (Hindu-Arabic numerals); Arabs transmitted them to Europe

facts.question: Is the 'funny bone' actually a bone?
facts.correct_answer: No - it is the ulnar nerve

facts.question: In which country did the Panama hat originate?
facts.correct_answer: Ecuador (they were shipped via Panama, hence the name)

facts.question: Is the turkey bird native to the country Turkey?
facts.correct_answer: No - the turkey bird is native to North America

facts.question: Is catgut (used in strings and sutures) made from cats?
facts.correct_answer: No - it is made from sheep or goat intestines

facts.question: Is a peanut a true nut?
facts.correct_answer: No - a peanut is a legume
